title: 4SD0 exam-style questions written for this lesson (lesson 77)
subject: Science (GCSE Biology, Chemistry, Physics)
source: Seeded from gcse-science/y10 lesson 77 (4SD0 exam-style questions written for this lesson (portal question sheet with mark scheme))
intro: Lesson 77: Photosynthesis practicals: leaf discs and the starch test. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Do the leaf disc practical at two lamp distances (or use the example data). Record time for 5 discs to float and explain the difference.
questions.a: Closer lamp: faster floating; more light, faster photosynthesis, more oxygen
questions.model: Teacher runs the disc practical on camera at 10 cm and records the first float time.

questions.q: Name the independent, dependent and two control variables.
questions.a: IV: distance; DV: time to float; controls: bicarbonate concentration, disc size, temperature

questions.q: Suggest why the leaf discs may sink again in the dark. (2)
questions.a: Respiration uses oxygen (1) and no photosynthesis replaces it (1)

questions.q: A variegated leaf is tested with iodine. Only the green parts go blue-black. Explain. (2)
questions.a: Green parts have chlorophyll so photosynthesise and make starch (1); white parts lack chlorophyll so make none (1)
questions.model: Link colour to chlorophyll, chlorophyll to photosynthesis, photosynthesis to starch.

questions.q: Why boil the leaf before the ethanol?
questions.a: To kill cells and stop reactions; make it permeable

questions.q: Why use a water bath, not a flame, for ethanol?
